cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmly Withholding
cards.instruction: Remain open, caring, and reassuring while revealing less with every new question.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort your wedding dress. It reached our depot this morning. Please sit; you're in good hands.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One of ours. I'll make the trip for you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you at least give me their number?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here, take my number. You can ring me any time.

reason: The clerk adapts the assistance to collection and phone requests while revealing progressively less about the dress; remove duplicate pleas and mechanism announcements.
